sloka: स वनम् प्रव्रजे त्युक्तोबाढ वित्येव वक्ष्यति ।राघवे हि वनम् प्राप्ते सर्वलोकस्य धिक्कृतम् ॥२-१२-८७॥
transliteration: sa vanam pravraje tyuktobāḍha vityeva vakṣyati ।rāghave hi vanam prāpte sarvalokasya dhikkṛtam ॥2-12-87॥

translations.english: The descendant of the Raghus (Rama) who is pure in thought will not come to know my intention. Therefore if I tell him 'Go to the forest,' he will say, 'Certainly so'.
